UK: Pokémon Night Out | First Look Teaser | #Pokemon30
Get ready for the worlds of Pokémon and dance music to collide. 🔊

Take a look behind-the-scenes at the making of Pokémon Night Out featuring live sets by Marshmello and Alison Wonderland, to see what you can expect from this once-in-a-lifetime concert experience!

Tickets for London on November 10 are available now: https://pkmn.news/NightOutTickets
